brief:
A newly built desalination plant in northern Gaza was destroyed, worsening an already acute drinking water crisis for displaced families in the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. The facility's loss removes a critical source of fresh water as Palestinians face severe scarcity amid ongoing displacement and humanitarian strain.

Displaced residents now struggle to locate clean drinking water with the plant out of operation. Families across northern Gaza depend on limited alternative sources as the destruction compounds months of existing shortages that have left the population without reliable access to safe water supplies. The loss of the facility leaves thousands of internally displaced people facing additional hardship in an environment where basic services remain severely constrained.
dek: After a newly built desalination plant was destroyed, displaced families in northern Gaza struggle to find clean water.
title: Destroyed desalination plant deepens Gaza's water shortage
